field.integerBetween: {field} must be an integer between {min} and {max}
field.wholeNumberFromTo: {field} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}

osd.customColor: OSD custom color must be a six-digit hex color
osd.clockFormat: OSD clock format must be 12 or 24 hour
osd.compactMetrics: OSD compact performance selection is invalid
osd.bodyOrder: OSD body order must contain each row once

binding.chordEmpty: {field} must include at least one key
binding.chordPrimaryKey: {field} must include exactly one non-modifier key
binding.inputPath: {field} must use button-1 through button-128 or hat-1 through hat-4 with a supported direction

framegen.flowQuality: {field} must be performance, balanced, or quality
framegen.diagnosticView: {field} must be off, flow, confidence, or tint

turbo.predictionPercent: Turbo experimental prediction dampening must be an integer from 50 to 100
turbo.frameLimit: Turbo experimental frame cap must be 0 (off) or an integer from 20 to 240

applications.idFormat: {field} must use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens

profiles.conflict: {profile} conflicts with profiles[{first}] for application {application}; first enabled profile wins

warnings.turboFrameGenOverlap: Turbo and Frame Generation are both on for {targets}. Frame Generation takes over frame pacing; Turbo stays off in sessions where Frame Generation runs.

store.loadBlocked: Settings could not be loaded, so saving is off to keep the file on disk: {error}. Fix the file and reopen VectorXR, import a config, or reset to defaults.
store.loadRuntimePacingFailed: Failed to load runtime pacing state
store.pacingVerdictCleared: Pacing verdict cleared for {runtime}; Auto re-discovers at the next session
store.configImported: Config imported — save to write to disk
